title: UI风格#195 - Minimalist Luxury (极简奢华)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Luxury style When color palette Then features cream, gold, charcoal, white
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FAF8F5 (奶油白), #D4AF37 (金), #2C2C2C (炭灰), #FFFFFF (白)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Luxury style When typography Then uses refined serif: Cormorant, Playfair Display

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Luxury style When layout Then generous whitespace, refined details, restrained elegance
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：大量留白、精致细节、克制优雅

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Luxury style When UI elements Then subtle gold accents, smooth transitions, fine lines

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Luxury UI When functional Then includes refined chat, luxury agents, elegance stats
